verdict.rationale: Two independent community reports confirm that LaunchDarkly offers multivariate flags, including one team using them to serve different per-batch data sizes (1MB/5MB/10MB) to agents. However, nothing in the pack documents the specific value types the story asks for: strings, numbers, or JSON dynamic configuration. Missing for 10: first-party docs on multivariate flag variation types, explicit evidence of string/number/JSON flag values, and SDK typed-evaluation details for dynamic config.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve multivariate flags and dynamic configuration values (strings, numbers, JSON), not just booleans

citations.quote: Multivariate flags let them throttle agent data (1MB/5MB/10MB per batch).
